title: DualFeat-SEW-CLIF MI-EEG frozen reproducibility evidence archive
description: Frozen source, configurations, trial-level predictions and logits, participant-level metrics, statistical scripts, provenance records, environment information, figures, and SHA-256 checksums supporting the manuscript 'Evidence for sample-regime-dependent benefits of structured spiking dynamics in motor-imagery EEG decoding'. Raw and processed EEG signals and feature caches are excluded because of third-party dataset licensing.
